title: China’s Fandom Economy (1)
synopsis: Many young fans will go to extreme lengths to show support for their idols.

fullText.simplified:
中国饭圈经济（一）

    爱美的心，每个人都有，青少年更是这样。他们很容易喜欢上一个唱歌好听的歌手，爱上一个跳舞厉害的人，或被一个帅气或者美丽的演员所吸引。这种情况让家长们很担心，虽然很多情况下他们都只是多虑了，但是近几年在中国青少年中流行的一种文化——饭圈文化，却让大部分父母都很难接受。
    饭圈文化，是喜欢流行明星的青少年们一起追星，慢慢产生的一种小文化。他们为了支持自己喜欢的明星，不停地去各地看演唱会、参加粉丝聚会。这些活动花费了他们大量的时间和金钱，令他们的父母十分头疼。
    与此同时，也产生了饭圈经济。不少人发现了粉丝身上巨大的消费能力，虽然这些追星的青少年们自己没有经济收入，但是他们对追星的热情，让他们的父母不得不付钱。这些粉丝除了花钱看演唱会，还会花钱购买明星代言的产品。为了更好地支持自己喜欢的明星，他们会不停地重复购买自己并不需要的产品。还出现过这样的情况：一位明星代言了一个品牌的酸奶，这位的明星的粉丝们就去超市把这个品牌的酸奶都买光了。他们喝不完这么多酸奶，就把瓶子里的酸奶扔掉，再把洗干净的酸奶瓶子带回家。因为对于他们来说，有明星照片的酸奶瓶才是自己要的东西。对于这样的浪费，许多人都表示不能理解。
    如此疯狂的饭圈经济，产生的原因是什么呢？我们下次再聊。
fullText.traditional:
中國飯圈經濟（一）

    愛美的心，每個人都有，青少年更是這樣。他們很容易喜歡上一個唱歌好聽的歌手，愛上一個跳舞厲害的人，或被一個帥氣或者美麗的演員所吸引。這種情況讓家長們很擔心，雖然很多情況下他們都只是多慮了，但是近幾年在中國青少年中流行的一種文化——飯圈文化，卻讓大部分父母都很難接受。
    飯圈文化，是喜歡流行明星的青少年們一起追星，慢慢產生的一種小文化。他們為了支持自己喜歡的明星，不停地去各地看演唱會、參加粉絲聚會。這些活動花費了他們大量的時間和金錢，令他們的父母十分頭疼。
    與此同時，也產生了飯圈經濟。不少人發現了粉絲身上巨大的消費能力，雖然這些追星的青少年們自己沒有經濟收入，但是他們對追星的熱情，讓他們的父母不得不付錢。這些粉絲除了花錢看演唱會，還會花錢購買明星代言的產品。為了更好地支持自己喜歡的明星，他們會不停地重複購買自己並不需要的產品。還出現過這樣的情況：一位明星代言了一個品牌的酸奶，這位的明星的粉絲們就去超市把這個品牌的酸奶都買光了。他們喝不完這麼多酸奶，就把瓶子裡的酸奶扔掉，再把洗乾淨的酸奶瓶子帶回家。因為對於他們來說，有明星照片的酸奶瓶才是自己要的東西。對於這樣的浪費，許多人都表示不能理解。
    如此瘋狂的飯圈經濟，產生的原因是什麼呢？我們下次再聊。

.. has been hard for most parents to accept.

sentences.simplified: 饭圈文化，是喜欢流行明星的青少年们一起追星，慢慢产生的一种小文化。
sentences.traditional: 飯圈文化，是喜歡流行明星的青少年們一起追星，慢慢產生的一種小文化。

sentences.simplified: 他们为了支持自己喜欢的明星，
sentences.traditional: 他們為了支持自己喜歡的明星，
sentences.pinyin: tā men wèi le zhī chí zì jǐ xǐ huan de míng xīng
sentences.english: Fandom culture is a subculture that has slowly arisen among young people who like pop stars and follow them together.

sentences.simplified: 不停地去各地看演唱会、参加粉丝聚会。
sentences.traditional: 不停地去各地看演唱會、參加粉絲聚會。
sentences.pinyin: bù tíng de qù gè dì kàn yǎn chàng huì cān jiā fěn sī jù huì
sentences.english: In order to support the celebrities they like, ..

sentences.simplified: 这些活动花费了他们大量的时间和金钱，令他们的父母十分头疼。
sentences.traditional: 這些活動花費了他們大量的時間和金錢，令他們的父母十分頭疼。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē huó dòng huā fèi le tā men dà liàng de shí jiān hé jīn qián lìng tā men de fù mǔ shí fēn tóu téng
sentences.english: .. they constantly go to different locations to see concerts and participate in fan gatherings.
These activities use up a great amount of their time and money, giving their parents a big headache.

sentences.simplified: 与此同时，也产生了饭圈经济。
sentences.traditional: 與此同時，也產生了飯圈經濟。
sentences.pinyin: yǔ cǐ tóng shí yě chǎn shēng le fàn quān jīng jì

sentences.simplified: 不少人发现了粉丝身上巨大的消费能力，
sentences.traditional: 不少人發現了粉絲身上巨大的消費能力，
sentences.pinyin: bù shǎo rén fā xiàn le fěn sī shēn shang jù dà de xiāo fèi néng lì
sentences.english: At the same time, it has given rise to the fandom economy.

sentences.simplified: 虽然这些追星的青少年们自己没有经济收入，
sentences.traditional: 雖然這些追星的青少年們自己沒有經濟收入，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhè xiē zhuī xīng de qīng shào nián men zì jǐ méi yǒu jīng jì shōu rù
sentences.english: Many people have discovered that fans have massive purchasing power.

sentences.simplified: 但是他们对追星的热情，让他们的父母不得不付钱。
sentences.traditional: 但是他們對追星的熱情，讓他們的父母不得不付錢。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā men duì zhuī xīng de rè qíng ràng tā men de fù mǔ bù dé bù fù qián
sentences.english: Although these young people who follow celebrities don’t have any financial income, ..

sentences.simplified: 这些粉丝除了花钱看演唱会，还会花钱购买明星代言的产品。
sentences.traditional: 這些粉絲除了花錢看演唱會，還會花錢購買明星代言的產品。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē fěn sī chú le huā qián kàn yǎn chàng huì hái huì huā qián gòu mǎi míng xīng dài yán de chǎn pǐn
sentences.english: .. their passion for following celebrities means that their parents have no choice but to pay.

sentences.simplified: 为了更好地支持自己喜欢的明星，他们会不停地重复购买自己并不需要的产品。
sentences.traditional: 為了更好地支持自己喜歡的明星，他們會不停地重複購買自己並不需要的產品。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le gèng hǎo de zhī chí zì jǐ xǐ huan de míng xīng tā men huì bù tíng de chóng fù gòu mǎi zì jǐ bìng bù xū yào de chǎn pǐn
sentences.english: Other than spending money on watching concerts, these fans also spend money to buy celebrity-endorsed products.

sentences.simplified: 还出现过这样的情况：一位明星代言了一个品牌的酸奶，
sentences.traditional: 還出現過這樣的情況：一位明星代言了一個品牌的酸奶，
sentences.pinyin: hái chū xiàn guò zhè yàng de qíng kuàng yí wèi míng xīng dài yán le yí ge pǐn pái de suān nǎi
sentences.english: In order to better support the celebrities they like, they are always repeatedly buying products that they don’t need.

sentences.simplified: 这位的明星的粉丝们就去超市把这个品牌的酸奶都买光了。
sentences.traditional: 這位的明星的粉絲們就去超市把這個品牌的酸奶都買光了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wèi de míng xīng de fěn sī men jiù qù chāo shì bǎ zhè ge pǐn pái de suān nǎi dōu mǎi guāng le
sentences.english: The following situation also occurs: A particular celebrity endorses a brand of yogurt.

sentences.simplified: 他们喝不完这么多酸奶，
sentences.traditional: 他們喝不完這麼多酸奶，
sentences.pinyin: tā men hē bù wán zhè me duō suān nǎi
sentences.english: This celebrity’s fans will go to the supermarket and buy out all of this brand’s yogurt.

sentences.simplified: 就把瓶子里的酸奶扔掉，再把洗干净的酸奶瓶子带回家。
sentences.traditional: 就把瓶子裡的酸奶扔掉，再把洗乾淨的酸奶瓶子帶回家。
sentences.pinyin: jiù bǎ píng zi lǐ de suān nǎi rēng diào zài bǎ xǐ gān jìng de suān nǎi píng zi dài huí jiā
sentences.english: They can’t consume that much yogurt, ..

sentences.simplified: 因为对于他们来说，有明星照片的酸奶瓶才是自己要的东西。
sentences.traditional: 因為對於他們來說，有明星照片的酸奶瓶才是自己要的東西。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi duì yú tā men lái shuō yǒu míng xīng zhào piàn de suān nǎi píng cái shì zì jǐ yào de dōng xi
sentences.english: .. so they pour the yogurt out of the bottles and take the cleanly-washed yogurt bottles home.

sentences.simplified: 对于这样的浪费，许多人都表示不能理解。
sentences.traditional: 對於這樣的浪費，許多人都表示不能理解。
sentences.pinyin: duì yú zhè yàng de làng fèi xǔ duō rén dōu biǎo shì bù néng lǐ jiě
sentences.english: Because for them, the yogurt bottles with the celebrity’s photo are what they really want.
Many people have expressed their lack of comprehension about this wastefulness.

sentences.simplified: 如此疯狂的饭圈经济，产生的原因是什么呢？我们下次再聊。
sentences.traditional: 如此瘋狂的飯圈經濟，產生的原因是什麼呢？我們下次再聊。
sentences.pinyin: rú cǐ fēng kuáng de fàn quān jīng jì chǎn shēng de yuán yīn shì shén me ne wǒ men xià cì zài liáo

sentences.english: What is the reason behind the formation of such a frenzied fandom economy? We will talk more next time.

raw.synopsis: Many young fans will go to extreme lengths to show support for their idols.
sentence_translations: China’s Fandom Economy (1)
Everyone loves beauty. This is especially true for young people.
They can easily fall in love with a singer who sings well, fall in love with someone who dances well, ..
.. or be attracted to a handsome or beautiful actor.
Such situations make parents very worried, even though in many situations they are overthinking it.
But in the last few years, a type of popular culture amongst Chinese youth, fandom culture, ..
.. has been hard for most parents to accept.
Fandom culture is a subculture that has slowly arisen among young people who like pop stars and follow them together.
In order to support the celebrities they like, ..
.. they constantly go to different locations to see concerts and participate in fan gatherings.
These activities use up a great amount of their time and money, giving their parents a big headache.
At the same time, it has given rise to the fandom economy.
Many people have discovered that fans have massive purchasing power.
Although these young people who follow celebrities don’t have any financial income, ..
.. their passion for following celebrities means that their parents have no choice but to pay.
Other than spending money on watching concerts, these fans also spend money to buy celebrity-endorsed products.
In order to better support the celebrities they like, they are always repeatedly buying products that they don’t need.
The following situation also occurs: A particular celebrity endorses a brand of yogurt.
This celebrity’s fans will go to the supermarket and buy out all of this brand’s yogurt.
They can’t consume that much yogurt, ..
.. so they pour the yogurt out of the bottles and take the cleanly-washed yogurt bottles home.
Because for them, the yogurt bottles with the celebrity’s photo are what they really want.
Many people have expressed their lack of comprehension about this wastefulness.
What is the reason behind the formation of such a frenzied fandom economy? We will talk more next time.
